decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed single-storey/part two storey rear extension, by reason of its position, height and excessive depth, would represent an obtrusive development which would result in enclosure, loss of light and outlook to the rear of the neighbouring properties, resulting in an unacceptable loss of residential amenity, contrary to adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 and revised deposit UDP (January 2001) policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002)

Condition : 2 - 2/ The conversion of the single-family dwellinghouse to three self-contained residential units would represent a cramped overdevelopment of the site which would result in inadequate room sizes, layout and substandard living accommodation, detrimental to the residential amenity of the occupiers, contrary to adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.1.2 and H.1.5, and revised deposit UDP policies (January 2001) ENV-B.1.1, H 4.1 and H.3.4.

Condition : 3 - 3/ The proposed parking arrangements, by reason of their inadequate layout and access, and the proposed additional vehicular crossover off Hanworth Road, would fail to provide the Council's parking standards, and would represent an unnecessary hazard resulting in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to policy T.2.5 of the Council's adopted UDP and policy T.1.4 of the revised deposit UDP (January 2001).
description: DEMOLITION OF EXISTING GARAGE AND ERECTION OF A TWO-STOREY SIDE EXTENSION, PART TWO-STOREY, PART SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION, CONVERSION TO 3 SELF-CONTAINED FLATS AND INSTALLATION OF A 2ND VEHICULAR CROSSOVER (APPLICATION REVALIDATED 30TH SEPTEMBER 2003).
